MAIN SEWER CONNECTIONS

A sound connection starts with careful planning.

Connecting a waste line involves more than joining two pipes. The existing line, alignment, access, and the broader project need to be understood before a connection is made. E&S’s experience includes main sewer tie-in work.

Get a Free EstimateCall (619) 507-4947
A PRACTICAL START

The details at the connection matter.

Existing and new drainage routes need to be considered together. Reviewing the connection location, line alignment, grading, and access helps establish the work ahead. Bring available plans so connection work can be discussed as part of the larger project.

  • Review the existing line and proposed route
  • Discuss excavation access and affected surfaces
  • Coordinate connection work with the overall project
